title: Get your 12 Google Play testers with Shipvo Testers

scenes.narration: Want your app on Google Play? New personal accounts have a rule. You need twelve testers, for fourteen days in a row. Here is how to find them.

Google asks for twelve people to opt in to a closed test. They must stay opted in for fourteen days in a row. If the count drops below twelve, the clock starts again. Company accounts skip this rule. So do personal accounts made before November thirteen, twenty twenty three.
Step one. Join Shipvo Testers. It is a group of founders who test each other's apps. Anyone can join. Members cannot see each other's emails.
Step two. In Play Console, make a closed test track. Upload your first build by hand. Play does not allow that step through the A P I. Then add the Shipvo Testers group to the track.
Or let Shipvo do it. Run shipvo store testers. It prints the steps for your app. Add your Play key, and it adds the group for you. It never removes a group.
Step three. Share your opt-in link with your own people. They open it, opt in, and install your app.
Step four. Test other apps. The community works because everyone tests. Keep them installed for the fourteen days.
We cannot promise how many people will opt in. But now you have a plan. Join at shipvo dot dev, slash testers.
scenes.caption: We cannot promise how many people will opt in. But now you have a plan. Join at shipvo.dev/testers.
